deck: Sketchy Pharm::5 GI & Endocrine::3 Thyroid, Parathyroid & Adrenal::3.3 - Teriparatide, Vitamin D, Cinacalcet, Sevelamer

question.text: Identify an important physiologic distinction between Teriparatide and endogenous PTH

answer.text:
(1) Teriparatide: Net bone formation
(2) Parathormone: Net bone resorption

(Pulsatile Teriparatide ⇒ bone formation. Constant dosing would likely instead lead to bone resorption)
